label: Sharon Street, A Darwinian Dilemma for…: Street classifies Railton’s account of individual…
locator: pp. 136–139, §7: value naturalism; especially p. 137 and note 42
interpretation: Street’s classification of the individual-welfare account only; not a reclassification of every Railton commitment, a refutation, or an identification of welfare with impartial moral rightness. The project’s appraiser-independence vocabulary is weaker, and Railton’s own natural-basis explanatory order remains separately recorded.
